settings.label: API token
settings.meaning: Calls Pipedrive as one user of one company, with that user's permissions. Sent in the x-api-token header.
settings.whereToFind: In the Pipedrive web app, Settings › Personal preferences › API (an admin may need to enable API access for the user). A user has a different token in each company. Pipedrive has no test mode: for test, use a developer sandbox company, requested with Pipedrive's form; its token looks the same.

settings.label: Company domain
settings.meaning: The company's subdomain: every call goes to https://<companyDomain>.pipedrive.com.
settings.whereToFind: The first part of the address the company's Pipedrive opens at: acme for https://acme.pipedrive.com.

settings.label: Webhook user name
settings.meaning: The HTTP Basic auth user name Pipedrive sends with every webhook, so the app can tell its webhooks from anyone else's requests. You choose it.
settings.whereToFind: Any value of your own: webhooks.create gives it to Pipedrive as http_auth_user.

settings.label: Webhook password
settings.meaning: The HTTP Basic auth password Pipedrive sends with every webhook. You choose it.
settings.whereToFind: A long random string of your own: webhooks.create gives it to Pipedrive as http_auth_password.

operations.name: persons.create
operations.purpose: Adds a person (a contact). API v2.

operations.name: persons.get
operations.purpose: Reads one person by id. API v2.

operations.name: persons.update
operations.purpose: Changes the given fields of a person. API v2.

operations.name: persons.list
operations.purpose: Lists persons, a page at a time by cursor. API v2.

operations.name: persons.search
operations.purpose: Searches persons by name, email, phone, notes or custom fields; with fields=email and exact_match=true, finds a person by email address (not case-sensitive). API v2.

operations.name: organizations.create
operations.purpose: Adds an organization (a company). API v2.

operations.name: organizations.get
operations.purpose: Reads one organization by id. API v2.

operations.name: organizations.search
operations.purpose: Searches organizations by name, address, notes or custom fields. API v2.

operations.name: deals.create
operations.purpose: Adds a deal, optionally linked to a person and an organization and placed in a stage. API v2.

operations.name: deals.get
operations.purpose: Reads one deal by id. API v2.

operations.name: deals.update
operations.purpose: Changes the given fields of a deal: its stage, status, value. API v2.

operations.name: deals.list
operations.purpose: Lists deals that aren't archived, a page at a time by cursor, optionally by person, organization, pipeline, stage or status. API v2.

operations.name: pipelines.list
operations.purpose: Lists the company's pipelines. API v2.

operations.name: stages.list
operations.purpose: Lists the stages of every pipeline, or of one. A deal's stage is set by a stage's id. API v2.

operations.name: personFields.list
operations.purpose: Lists the person fields, each with its field_code: the key a value is set under (a 40-character hash for a custom field). API v2.

operations.name: organizationFields.list
operations.purpose: Lists the organization fields, each with its field_code. API v2.

operations.name: dealFields.list
operations.purpose: Lists the deal fields, each with its field_code. API v2.

operations.name: notes.create
operations.purpose: Adds a note (HTML content, sanitized by Pipedrive) to a person, organization or deal. API v1: notes have no v2 endpoint.

operations.name: notes.list
operations.purpose: Lists notes, optionally of one person, organization or deal, a page at a time by offset (start, limit). API v1.

operations.name: webhooks.create
operations.purpose: Subscribes a URL to an event (event_action and event_object), as a v2 webhook sent with the webhook user name and password as HTTP Basic auth. API v1: webhooks have no v2 endpoint.

operations.name: webhooks.list
operations.purpose: Lists the company's webhooks. API v1.

operations.name: webhooks.delete
operations.purpose: Deletes a webhook. API v1.

signature.description: Pipedrive doesn't sign webhooks. When a webhook is made with http_auth_user and http_auth_password, Pipedrive sends them on every delivery as Authorization: Basic followed by the base64 of user:password. Decode it, split at the first colon, and compare the user name with the webhookUser setting and the password with the webhookPassword setting, each in constant time; refuse the delivery unless both match. The v2 body is { meta, data, previous }: meta.id is the event's id, meta.action is create, change or delete, and meta.entity is the object type.

events.meaning: A person was changed: data is the person now, previous holds the fields that changed.
A person was deleted: data is null, previous is the person as it was.
A deal was changed: its stage, status, value or another field.
